rationale: All devices went offline simultaneously at ~7am after a router replacement, with the base station showing solid red LED, online=False, uplink=no_internet, and E-503 in logs — a system-level uplink failure, not a peripheral fault. The standard L1 fix (power-cycling router then base station) restored the uplink: LED turned solid blue and all cameras/sensors came back online in the app.

repair_steps: Confirm the base station LED is solid blue and all devices show online in the app.
Verify the Ethernet cable is securely connected to a LAN port on the new router.
Advise the customer to keep the router and base station powered on and avoid unplugging them.
Document the resolution: router replacement caused uplink failure; power-cycle of router then base station restored connectivity.
Close the ticket as resolved at frontline.
output.customer_reply: I'm glad to hear your system is back online! The issue was caused by the new router not establishing a proper connection with the base station. Power-cycling both devices resolved it. Your cameras and sensors should now be working normally. If anything goes offline again, please check that the Ethernet cable is firmly plugged into a LAN port on the router and restart both devices. Have a great day!

args.question: What colour is the LED on the base station right now, and is the base station connected to the new router via an Ethernet cable (and if so, which port is it plugged into)?

args.action: Ask the customer to check the Ethernet cable from the base station to the new router: it must be plugged into one of the router's LAN ports (usually numbered 1-4, often yellow), NOT the WAN/Internet port. Have them unplug and reseat it firmly into a LAN port, then check if the base station LED changes from solid red to solid green/blue within a minute or two.

Ask the customer to power-cycle both devices: unplug the new router's power for 30 seconds and plug it back in, then unplug the base station's power for 30 seconds and plug it back in. Wait 2-3 minutes, then check whether the base station LED changes from solid red to solid green/blue and whether devices come back online in the app.
